sprint: Text Resize — A Real Freeze Fix, Traced to an Invented Font-Scaling Mechanism With No Builder Counterpart
task: a real, user-reported bug: resizing a World-owned text object after repositioning it made the center pane freeze visually while the model kept changing underneath. Three faithful Playwright reproductions failed to reproduce it until the user's own clarifying reply -- "am only testing the rules which builder has provided and are they getting honored" -- pointed the investigation at Creator Governing Rule #2 (Guardrails). Root cause: renderer/slideRenderer.js's _layerDrawText derived a font-size scale from a resize override, clamped to Math.max(0.2,Math.min(6,scale)) -- past 6x the object's natural width, the render silently pinned at that ceiling while the underlying size override kept climbing unbounded on every further drag. A deeper Fidelity (Rule #1) violation was found in the same investigation: Builder's own reference renderer (engineRuntime.js) never scales font size off a resized text box at all -- only wrap width changes, height is always derived from the resulting line count -- and Studio's own freeform text stickers already correctly followed that model; only this one Layer Pack text path had invented a divergent mechanism. Fixed by removing the scale/clamp entirely: a size override's width now becomes the wrap width directly, font size is never touched by resize, and height keeps deriving from wrapped line count, matching both Builder and Studio's own sibling convention exactly. Verified via direct before/after multiplier sweeps (confirmed the render tree froze at 6x pre-fix while the model climbed to 12x; confirmed genuine, continuous, unbounded rewrapping post-fix with zero re-introduced ceiling) plus a corrected text_resize_grid_test.js (switched from an outward corner drag, which legitimately has zero visual effect once short text already fits on one line matching Builder, to a horizontal side-handle drag that reliably forces multi-line rewrap regardless of aspect ratio) and full regression across the existing Creator Playwright suite, all passing unchanged. See CLAUDE.md's own entry for the full account.
